segment.source: Renders two passages of prose in facing columns under their own headings, so a reader can compare them line for line. Use it for: before and after wording, the old rule against the new one, two translations of the same paragraph, a claim next to its correction, two positions in a debate. Prefer 'Pros and Cons' when each side is a list of points, and 'Text with Media' when one of the two sides is a picture.
